lowres_ok: Nintendo store: 720p is the only copy at reveal time on show night (Steam 1080p exists for this game, not used, to test the real path)
note: Nintendo Customer Support (Japan) on X, 30 Oct 08:00Z (read via the public embed 09:20Z): the 'Trick or Treat!' event in Kirby Air Riders is cancelled after a bug that can freeze the screen temporarily during play; Game*Spark adds the event will be held again later (29 Oct to 3 Nov JST, City Trial, Halloween rewards). Japanese notice; no return date. Footage: Nintendo's Kirby Air Riders overview trailer (Nintendo US store CDN), the music-led montage 350 to 377 s (narration runs 17 to 349 s and resumes at the logo).
